+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import os
+import sys
+import typing as t
+
+from .core import Command
+
+
+class SuggestEnvironment(Command):
+    """A :class:`~click.core.Command` whose default shell completion
+    environment variable ends with ``_SUGGEST`` instead of ``_COMPLETE``.
+    """
+
+    def _main_shell_completion(
+        self,
+        ctx_args: cabc.MutableMapping[str, t.Any],
+        prog_name: str,
+        complete_var: str | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Check if the shell is asking for tab completion, process
+        that, then exit early. Called from :meth:`main` before the
+        program is invoked.
+
+        :param prog_name: Name of the executable in the shell.
+        :param complete_var: Name of the environment variable that holds
+            the completion instruction. Defaults to
+            ``_{PROG_NAME}_SUGGEST``.
+        """
+        if complete_var is None:
+            complete_name = prog_name.replace("-", "_").replace(".", "_")
+            complete_var = f"_{complete_name}_SUGGEST".upper()
+
+        instruction = os.environ.get(complete_var)
+
+        if not instruction:
+            return
+
+        from .shell_completion import shell_complete
+
+        rv = shell_complete(self, ctx_args, prog_name, complete_var, instruction)
+        sys.exit(rv)

+++ b/tests/test_suggest_environment.py
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+import pytest
+
+from click.suggest_environment import SuggestEnvironment
+
+
+def _cmd():
+    return SuggestEnvironment("my-cli.py", callback=lambda: None)
+
+
+def test_default_var_uses_suggest(monkeypatch, capsys):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("_MY_CLI_PY_SUGGEST", "bash_source")
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as e:
+        _cmd().main([], prog_name="my-cli.py")
+    assert e.value.code == 0
+    assert "_MY_CLI_PY_SUGGEST" in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+
+def test_complete_var_ignored(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("_MY_CLI_PY_COMPLETE", "bash_source")
+    assert _cmd().main([], prog_name="my-cli.py", standalone_mode=False) is None
+
+
+def test_explicit_complete_var(monkeypatch, capsys):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("CUSTOM", "bash_source")
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        _cmd().main([], prog_name="my-cli.py", complete_var="CUSTOM")
+    assert "CUSTOM" in capsys.readouterr().out
